q: Which is the longest river in India?
exp: The Ganga (2,525 km) is the longest river flowing entirely within India. Answer: Ganga

q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
exp: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram. Answer: 8

q: Which state has the longest coastline in India?
exp: Gujarat has the longest coastline (about 1,600 km) among Indian states. Answer: Gujarat

q: The Sundarbans mangrove forest is located in which delta?
exp: The Sundarbans lies in the Ganga-Brahmaputra delta. Answer: Ganga-Brahmaputra

q: Which is the highest peak entirely within India?
exp: Nanda Devi (7,816 m, Uttarakhand) is the highest peak entirely within India. Answer: Nanda Devi

q: The Deccan Plateau is primarily composed of which type of rock?
exp: The Deccan Plateau is largely made of basaltic (volcanic) rock from the Deccan Traps. Answer: Basalt

q: Which Indian state is the largest by area?
exp: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area. Answer: Rajasthan

q: The Western Ghats are a biodiversity hotspot stretching across which states?
opts: Maharashtra to Tamil Nadu (including Goa, Karnataka, Kerala)
exp: The Western Ghats run from Gujarat through Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala to Tamil Nadu. Answer: Maharashtra to Tamil Nadu (including Goa, Karnataka, Kerala)

q: Which river forms the Jog Falls in Karnataka?
exp: The Sharavathi River forms the Jog Falls. Answer: Sharavathi

q: The Indira Gandhi Canal draws water from which rivers?
exp: The Indira Gandhi Canal takes water from the Harike barrage at the confluence of the Sutlej and Beas. Answer: Sutlej and Beas

q: Which Indian city is known as the 'Pink City'?
exp: Jaipur is known as the Pink City. Answer: Jaipur

q: The Chilika Lake (largest brackish water lagoon in India) is in which state?
exp: Chilika Lake is in Odisha. Answer: Odisha

q: Which pass connects Leh with Manali?
exp: Rohtang Pass connects the Kullu Valley (Manali) with the Lahaul Valley (toward Leh). Answer: Rohtang Pass

q: The largest state in India by population (2011 Census) is?
exp: Uttar Pradesh had the highest population in the 2011 Census. Answer: Uttar Pradesh

q: Which soil is most suitable for cotton cultivation in India?
exp: Black (regur) soil of the Deccan Trap is best suited for cotton. Answer: Black (regur) soil
